A holy grail for Pearl Jam collectors. Rarely available at auction, this 2004 Live at Benaroya Hall 4 LP wine-colored vinyl box set is still sealed and in mint condition.

Bid for the #1 person on your holiday list. It’s okay if that’s you.

All proceeds benefit Vitalogy Foundation. Link in bio.
